review_method: Independent source/math contract review, authenticated archive and frozen ancestor-source reconstruction, strict reparse of all 46 named native reports. No reviewer Lean invocation.
scope: Two frozen completion sampler modules, 46 audited declarations; no whole-build or outer-machine certification.
boundaries: Polynomial cost is in the complete encoded input including supplied random word, not a polynomial in log of an implicitly enormous bank length.
No final physical/reference list-order/neighbor initialization/reconstruction or adaptive outer walk/retry semantics is proved by these two modules.
No final public literal RandomMachine or parser/printer/public-size cost instantiation, full runtime exponent, measured speed, whole batch success, aggregate or Linux count increase is claimed.
Degree62 fine-word allowance, degree85 reserved-bank allowance and degree170 public-size allowance remain distinct from the program polynomial whose degree is not extracted here.

mathematical_contracts.actual_program_input: Parameters=((coarse row list,coarse column list),(binary d,binary h)); draw input additionally supplies a literal Bool list. No fine table, accuracy premise, feasible table witness or precomputed fine margins is a program input.
mathematical_contracts.preparation: k=d^12; each row becomes k*(entry+2*column-list-length) and each column k*(entry+2*row-list-length). q=h+2+clog2(4*(h+2)); inner canonical parameters retain d and q. prepare_code preserves exact original finite row/column order through Option encoding.
mathematical_contracts.fine_trial: Unchanged canonicalDenseDraw computes its origin, internal fallback and normalized draw; verified natural signed-test-before-truncation decoder returns Option MatrixCode. trial_code is exact success/rejection equality to CompletionBooleanRetry.tableTrial.map matrixCode.
mathematical_contracts.reserved_words: wordWidth is computed canonicalBitCount; bitCount=J*wordWidth, J=4(h+2). reservedWords first takes supplied prefix bitCount, then enumerates exactly floor(prefix.length/wordWidth) complete contiguous words in original order. Zero width gives no words. Arbitrary short words give fewer complete trials; surplus suffix bits add no trials. Valid finite words have positive width and exactly J segments.
mathematical_contracts.greedy_fallback: draw computes unchanged GreedyFeasibleTable.listMatrix on original coarse lists. Semantics proves exact identity with a feasible typed table on equal-total margins. All-rejection mass is returned there; a successful result numerically equal to fallback remains a success.
mathematical_contracts.retry_evaluation: FirstSuccessProgram.retry maps trial across all reserved words, then firstSome selects the first some and defaults to greedy fallback. The realizer evaluates the map/filter list; no early-stop cost saving is established.
mathematical_contracts.exact_word_law: draw_code matches every uniform-bank input pointwise to matrixCode(programTable). programTable is precisely DenseLatticeCompletion.completionDraw with computed greedy coarse fallback. Imported completionDraw_law/flat product-word equivalence gives normalized independent retry law, not conditioning on acceptance. No artificial Fintype instance for infinite MatrixCode space is used.
mathematical_contracts.long_reserved_words: draw_prefix_code proves actual list draw ignores bits beyond computed width; padded_programTable_law proves uniform N-bit prefix has exactly the original typed law for any N>=completionBits. Accuracy follows unchanged for supplied state-independent reservations. These statements do not by themselves construct the adaptive outer word bank.
mathematical_contracts.accuracy_hypotheses: d>=14, nonempty full dimensions m+1,n+1<=d, free m*n<=d-1, equal totals, each R_i>=(n+1)*3d and P_j>=(m+1)*3d. h is any Nat, including0. programTable_variation/padded_programTable_variation/draw_semantics prove full normalized TV<=2^-h. Analytic inputs, count comparison, ideal quarter acceptance and fine-law accuracy are discharged by existing published proved modules.
mathematical_contracts.polynomial_charged_cost: polynomial_draw is an actual PolynomialTime drawRealizer witness in pinned TreeTyped: there exists Nat polynomial P with F.cost x+weight(draw x)<=P.eval(weight x), for every input, including malformed lists/parameters/words. Input weight includes binary margins,d,h and the whole supplied Bool list. Output size and all intermediate sizes are charged by polynomial composition.
mathematical_contracts.numeric_dimension_safety: d^12 and J are arithmetic binary outputs. No List.range of unrestricted binary d,h,J or bitCount is generated. Rows/columns enumerate supplied list lengths; completeWordRows range bound is prefix.length/wordWidth<=supplied.length<=input weight. takeFast consumes at most the actual list rather than iterating to huge binary width.
mathematical_contracts.totality_boundary: All-natural list functions and supplied-word recursion are total on arbitrary/malformed inputs. Typed feasibility, positive width and accuracy are asserted only under stated valid margins/dimension/word assumptions; total malformed output need not be a feasible table.
